metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘eh, let’s just confuse them all’
metadata.description:
Wait, did the enemy forget this was a shooter?
My aim was on break but got the kill anyway.
Click if your shots are mostly accidental miracles.

Tap if your kills make no sense but you flex anyway!
